current: Every path a decision takes reaches the evaluation input — the platform's hash-chained outcome capture (qip_twin::capture::OutcomeCapture, held by Platform, counted by the LEARN stage and read by the twin's counterfactual pricing) — under a decision id of its own. A fill: Platform::capture_submission records OrderPlaced and then Filled (caused_by the placement's decision id) with the order manager's order id, quantity and price, in the seam that books the same fill into TrackedCapital. A refused order: Action::Rejected with the order id and the gate. An opportunity that lapsed in the queue before REASON took it up: Platform::capture_unworked, called from stage_discover where the queue's retain used to drop it and report only a count, records Action::ExpiredOpportunity with the opportunity id, the instant it was first seen and how long it waited. REASON marks the opportunity it takes up (worked_opportunities), so the head of the queue is not also filed as unworked. No record can be built without a Decision, whose constructor requires a decision id and a trace. qip-learning-engine's attribution, thesis grading and calibration derive from the same fills and resolved theses, as before.
